title: SIP Churn Taxonomy & Addressability Breakdown

classifications.label: Behavioral & Psychological Friction
classifications.addressability_summary: Highly addressable through reframing unit accumulation, milestone acknowledgment, and proactive market context.

classifications.label: Structural & Technical UX Friction
classifications.addressability_summary: Directly addressable by fixing mandate deduction timing, Demat T+2 status tracking, and flexible pause controls.

key_subtypes.subtype: Coin SIP vs AMC SIP Rigidity

classifications.label: Genuine Financial Hardship
classifications.addressability_summary: Non-addressable life shocks (job loss, medical emergency, sudden debt). Product role is simply to allow emergency withdrawal without guilt or punitive exit hurdles.

key_takeaway: Over 89% of first-year SIP drop-offs (99.5%) stem from addressable behavioral expectations and UX hurdles, rather than catastrophic financial hardship.
